packs.title: Kubernetes
packs.description: Dashboards, alerts and saved views for Kubernetes clusters.
packs.paused_impact: pods crash or run out of memory, or a deployment loses replicas

folder.name: Kubernetes
folder.description: Installed by the Kubernetes starter pack

dashboards.title: Kubernetes Overview
dashboards.summary: Clusters, nodes, pods and workloads in one view

saved_views.name: Kubernetes events
saved_views.summary: Every Kubernetes event in one searchable list

alert_summaries.k8s/pod_crashloop_backoff: Pods crash and restart over and over
alert_summaries.k8s/pod_oom_killed: Containers killed for running out of memory (OOM)
alert_summaries.k8s/deployment_replica_mismatch: Deployment below its desired pod count for 15m
alert_summaries.k8s/node_high_memory_usage: Node memory use at or above 80%
alert_summaries.k8s/oom_killing_events: Node is killing processes to free memory (OOM)
alert_summaries.k8s/apiserver_high_latency: API server p99 request time at 1 s or more
alert_summaries.k8s/cluster_cpu_capacity_high: Pod CPU requests use 80%+ of cluster capacity
alert_summaries.k8s/cluster_memory_capacity_high: Pod memory requests use 80%+ of cluster capacity
alert_summaries.k8s/cluster_pod_count_high: Cluster at 90%+ of the pods it can hold

tile_summaries.dashboards: Clusters, nodes, pods and workloads in one view
tile_summaries.alerts: Crash loops, OOM kills, node memory and cluster capacity
tile_summaries.saved_views: Every Kubernetes event in one searchable list

packs.title: Hosts
packs.description: The host metrics dashboard for servers and virtual machines.

folder.name: Hosts
folder.description: Installed by the Hosts starter pack

dashboards.title: Host Metrics
dashboards.summary: CPU, memory, disk and network for every host

packs.paused_impact: a host runs out of CPU, memory or disk, or stops reporting

alert_summaries.opentelemetry/host_high_cpu_load_otel: Host CPU over 90% busy for 15 minutes
alert_summaries.opentelemetry/host_out_of_memory_otel: Host memory over 90% used for 15 minutes
alert_summaries.opentelemetry/host_out_of_disk_space_ote: Host disk over 95% full for 10 minutes
alert_summaries.opentelemetry/host_stopped_reporting: Host stopped sending metrics: down or agent off
alert_summaries.opentelemetry/host_disk_may_fill_in_24_h: Disk over 80% full and may fill within 24 hours
alert_summaries.opentelemetry/host_cpu_load_saturation_o: Host load over 2x its CPUs, work is queuing

tile_summaries.dashboards: CPU, memory, disk and network for every host
tile_summaries.alerts: High CPU, memory or load, full disks, silent hosts

packs.title: Traces (APM)

folder.name: Traces
folder.description: Installed by the Traces starter pack

dashboards.title: Traces APM
dashboards.summary: Requests, errors and latency per service

packs.paused_impact: a service's error rate or latency climbs, or a dependency starts failing

alert_summaries.apm/traces_service_error_rate_high: Service errors above 5% of requests in 10 min
alert_summaries.apm/traces_service_p95_latency_high: Service p95 latency above 2 s in 10 min
alert_summaries.apm/traces_dependency_error_rate_high: Calls to a dependency fail over 10% in 10 min
alert_summaries.apm/traces_operation_error_burst: One endpoint hit 20+ errors (5%+) in 10 min

tile_summaries.dashboards: Requests, errors and latency per service
tile_summaries.alerts: Error rate, slow requests and failing dependencies
